description: Create a proposal, for a human signer to approve, that turns auto-earn off for the whole workspace from the Treasury. It covers every network where auto-earn is on (autoEarn.enabledChainIds in `settings get`) and stops auto-earn on every account that has it. Requires an org owner or a Treasury signer, and fails while another auto-earn proposal is pending. Returns the proposal with the chainIds it covers and a signUrl.

memo.description: Optional memo for the transaction (max 500 chars)

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: transactions_create_auto-earn-off
